fusions.name: Quarry Dump
fusions.desc: Tips a load of quarry stone onto the first enemy in its path. It deals 30 damage, and 80% of that to every other enemy within 3.5 tiles of where it lands.

fusions.name: Spun Gravel
fusions.desc: Your wheels throw up 4 stones at once, spread apart; each deals 2 damage, with a 30% chance to leave its target [Slowed] for 2 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Bogged to the Hubs
fusions.desc: Churns the ground to mud under every creature within 4 tiles, holding each in place for 3 seconds and leaving it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Ballast
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, a shield worth 30% of your maximum health settles over you for 6 seconds. Once every 60 seconds. You have 10% earth resistance.
